arguments.sql:
WITH power_counts AS (
    SELECT hp.hero_id, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS power_count
    FROM main.hero_power AS hp
    LEFT JOIN main.superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
    GROUP BY hp.hero_id
),
names AS (
    SELECT s.id, g.gender, s.superhero_name, TRIM(s.full_name) AS full_name, pc.record_count, pc.power_count
    FROM main.superhero AS s
    JOIN main.gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
    LEFT JOIN power_counts AS pc ON pc.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
)
SELECT gender, 'all heroes' AS category, COUNT(*) AS heroes,
       COUNT(record_count) AS heroes_with_power_records, SUM(COALESCE(power_count, 0)) AS powers,
       SUM(COALESCE(record_count - power_count, 0)) AS extra_power_records
FROM names
GROUP BY gender
UNION ALL
SELECT gender, 'space in full name', COUNT(*), COUNT(record_count), SUM(COALESCE(power_count, 0)),
       SUM(COALESCE(record_count - power_count, 0))
FROM names
WHERE full_name LIKE '% %'
GROUP BY gender
UNION ALL
SELECT gender, COALESCE(full_name, '[NULL]'), 1, record_count IS NOT NULL, COALESCE(power_count, 0),
       COALESCE(record_count - power_count, 0)
FROM names
WHERE id IN (83, 341, 410, 431, 474, 557, 586, 587, 610, 632, 673, 674, 675, 676, 730, 735, 745)
   OR (full_name NOT LIKE '% %' AND full_name GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z-]*')

WITH hero_power_counts AS (
    SELECT s.id, g.gender, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM main.superhero AS s
    JOIN main.gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
    LEFT JOIN main.hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
       OR (
           g.gender = 'Female'
           AND TRIM(s.full_name) LIKE '% %'
           AND TRIM(s.full_name) NOT IN (
               'Anna Marie',
               'Cyberdyne Systems Series X Terminator',
               'Diana of Themyscira'
           )
       )
    GROUP BY s.id, g.gender
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gender = 'Male' THEN power_count END), 2) AS male_average,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gender = 'Female' THEN power_count END), 2) AS female_average
FROM hero_power_counts

               'Cyberdyne Systems Series X Terminator',
               'Diana of Themyscira'
           )
       )
    GROUP BY s.id, g.gender
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gender = 'Male' THEN power_count END), 2) AS male_average,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gender = 'Female' THEN power_count END), 2) AS female_average
FROM hero_power_counts
LIMIT 1000
